text:
sam: Hey team — planning to bring up eu-west5 GPU cluster tomorrow AM. Main risk is image cold-starts and signed-image replication across our mirror. Need a quick checklist and handoff window.
maria: +1. We should prime the image cache and validate cosign verification flow.
kevin: Do we have quota for egress to our central registry from eu-west5? can spike cost if we naive-pull everything.
sam: I checked: billing says budgeted for 10TB egress this month, but I'd rather avoid pulling full model tiers. Plan: pre-pull only the 2 prod model variants and a lightweight smoke model.
alex: For priming, I can run a parallel kube-job that pulls and pushes images into the regional registry mirror. Script uses `skopeo copy` + signed manifest verification via `cosign`. Example command:
```
skopeo copy --src-tls-verify=false docker://gcr.io/redwood/models:v2 docker://eu-registry.redwood/internal/models:v2
cosign verify --key /secrets/registry-key.pub eu-registry.redwood/internal/models:v2
```
maria: Also add `imagePullSecrets` to the Helm values for `regional-registry` so node bootstrap can pull without hitting central auth.
kevin: Reminder: our mirror uses presigned GET tokens with 15m expiry. For kubelets we need a refresh sidecar or node-level long-lived key. ops-jen has a node bootstrap patch.
ops-jen: I pushed a Helm values patch to `charts/registry-mirror/values-eu-west5.yaml` with `nodePullToken: longlived` toggle (for onboarding only). Will revert to short tokens after handoff.
kevin: Good. Make sure to document the security exception in the handoff. I'll open a short PR in infra/docs.
sam: What about artifact replication rate limits? we don't want to DDOS the origin.
alex: We can use `rclone` with `--bwlimit` or `skopeo` with `--retry-delay` and stagger jobs across nodes. Proposed: 5 parallel workers per region, 30s delay between image groups.
maria: Smoke tests after priming:
- deploy `gpu-smoke` namespace helm chart with `models: [smoke-tiny, prod-v2]`
- run `python load_test.py --qps 10 --duration 3m` against local endpoint
- check `kv-cache` hit rate > 50% within 5 minutes
- verify cosign signatures for all pulled images

kevin: Monitoring hooks: add a short-lived dashboard for `eu-west5/registry` showing `pull/sec`, `egress_bytes`, `cosign_verify_failures`. Use our console template `reg-mirror-quick`.
infra-oncall: I'll add an oncall alert for `cosign_verify_failures > 1` in 10m and `egress_bytes` jump > 1GB/min.
sam: Handoff window: 2025-06-12 09:00-11:00 UTC. I'll be primary, @maria backup, @infra-oncall for alerts.
ops-jen: I'll create a k8s job manifest to prime prefixes: `primeset.yaml` with 3 jobs (models, weights, utils). Example: `kubectl apply -f primeset.yaml -n infra`.
alex: One last gotcha: Helm chart for `gpu-nodepool` had `maxUnavailable: 0` which slows rollout. For bootstrap set `maxUnavailable: 1` to reduce time to steady-state. Remember to revert before final SLA handoff.
maria: Cost note for docs: estimated extra egress ~= 600GB for two model tiers, costing ~ $45 in eu-west5. Add to PR.
kevin: I'll run a dry-run of the replication process in our staging region (asia-west-staging) tonight and share timings.
sam: ok all — small checklist for morning:
1) ops-jen deploy primeset job
2) alex run cosign verification sweep and report failures
3) infra-oncall enable dashboards/alerts
4) deploy `gpu-smoke` and run load test
5) confirm helm `imagePullSecrets` and `maxUnavailable` toggles
6) handoff note in #customer-success once pass

deploy-bot: [deploy] primeset job created: job/primeset-2001 in namespace infra by ops-jen :white_check_mark:
kevin: Shared timings in PR: initial pull 1.8s per small image, large model ~ 45s on first pull from central, mirror reduced to 6s on second region pulls.
maria: If any cosign fails, do not promote to prod region. We'll rollback mirror to previous snapshot and investigate.
sam: Thanks everyone. We'll post a quick summary after the window. :shipit:
